subject: Concordat: staged dataset provisioning & MAP
messages:
From: Timothy Lang <timothy@ingram.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@acme-corp.com>
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Concordat — initial dataset exchange & MAP kickoff

Hi Mina / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the ingestion performance looked promising. Per our call, Ingram AI is prepared to share a staged evaluation bundle so your team can run the promptpack/testcases in our sandbox.

High-level ask: can Redwood provide a mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out provisioning windows, acceptance gates, retention limits, and a close timeline so Procurement & Legal here can greenlight the handover? We need:
- A list of expected artifacts and sizes (sample_manifest attached).
- Sandbox access model (ephemeral creds preferred).
- Data handling constraints (no redistribution, retention window, destruction cert).
- Acceptance criteria for our QA (pass/fail thresholds, sample runs).

Proposed runway: 2-week staging, 1-week acceptance, then vendor sign-off for pilot (we're targeting a May 17 start).

Attaching: sample_manifest_v0.csv (list of 120 prompt/testcase ids, obfuscated PII).

Ping me if you want to sync on the MAP template; would prefer a short, prescriptive doc we can attach to the MPA.

Best,
Tim
Timothy Lang
Head of Integrations, Ingram AI

---
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Timothy Lang <timothy@ingram.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Concordat — initial dataset exchange & MAP kickoff

Timothy — thanks for the clear ask and the manifest. I sketched a short staged concordat MAP (attached) that covers provisioning, usage constraints, and an acceptance checklist. Key points up front:

- Provisioning windows: two sandbox bursts (5 days each) separated by a 48-hour freeze for redaction/verification.
- Access model: ephemeral tokens generated per-session, scoped to project:concordat, revoked automatically after the window.
- Retention: all raw inputs removed after 30 days; hashed embeddings retained for debug for 90 days max.
- Redistribution: no external redistribution; no public release of prompt/testcase content.
- Allowed use: evaluation, reproduction of results for acceptance only; no reuse in training models or downstream products.
- Auditing: we will supply an access log slice and a destroyed-data attestation PDF when takedown is complete.

Acceptance criteria (brief):
1) Pass >= 90% on labeled correctness checks across agreed test subset (10k examples) OR show documented false-positive/negative remediation plan.
2) Throughput & latency within agreed SLAs for 95th percentile when run under the accepted batch profile.
3) No validated PII leakage in sample outputs after automated filtering.

I've attached a draft MAP (mina_concordat_map_draft.pdf) and put a suggested timeline inside:
- May 10–14: Staging burst #1 (ingest + smoke tests)
- May 16–20: Staging burst #2 (full promptpack run)
- May 21–24: Acceptance review and remediation (if needed)
- May 25: Final sign-off / MPA close

Ben, Karthik — please weigh in on operational constraints and pricing cadence; Marissa I looped you for legal/compliance pre-reads.

Cheers,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: mina_concordat_map_draft.pdf (3 pages)

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Timothy Lang <timothy@ingram.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Concordat — staged dataset provisioning & MAP

Quick operational notes from infra / Dedicated side:

- We will provision a two-node ephemeral pool in us-west1 for the bursts. The pool will be isolated to the concordat project and have logging pushed to a customer-scoped object store for the 30-day retention window.
- Suggested batch profile: max tokens 2k, dynamic batching up to 32 concurrent requests; this will keep 95p latency under 600ms on our reserved G4-rics. If Ingram expects longer sequences we should re-profile.
- KV prefix caching: we can pre-warm common prompt prefixes but will need a list of high-frequency prefixes from your team to avoid cache misses during acceptance runs.
- Metrics we will publish to you: per-request latency, per-token cost estimate, and a sample of output hashes for PII check.

I'll attach the operational playbook we plan to use for staging (staging_playbook.md). Two asks for your team:
1) Confirm the 10k labeled subset for correctness checks (id list from sample_manifest).
2) Provide the high-frequency prefix list by May 6 so we can pre-warm caches ahead of burst #1.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Runtime Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachment: staging_playbook.md (operational runbook, 8 sections)

---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Timothy Lang <timothy@ingram.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@acme-corp.com>
Date: Wed, 04 May 2027 14:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Concordat — MAP & commercial runway

Thanks team — short commercial note to align expectations so Procurement can move faster:

- Pricing for the two staged bursts + acceptance window: flat evaluation credit of $8,500 (covers infra and ops support for the two bursts). Any overages billed at standard pay-as-you-go rates.
- If Ingram commits to a pilot (post-acceptance) within 30 days, we'll credit 50% of the evaluation fee against the pilot reserved capacity agreement.
- Procurement deliverable list: signed MAP + inbound data processing addendum + PO referencing DEAL-4952-Concordat.

Attachments: pricing_schedule.xlsx (line-item evaluation fee).

Timothy — is Procurement able to return the PO + signed MAP by May 21? If so, we can keep the May 25 sign-off target.

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, legal@ingram.ai
Date: Thu, 05 May 2027 18:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Concordat: staged dataset provisioning & MAP — final schedule

All — thanks for the input. Confirming the MAP & timeline with the following consolidated asks before we kick:

1) Ingram: finalize the 10k labeled subset id list and the high-frequency prefix file by EOD May 6.
2) Ingram Legal: review the short inbound data processing addendum we shared in the draft MAP; we need a signed copy to proceed with sandbox creds.
3) Redwood: Karthik's team will deliver pre-warmed cache and the access log slice; Mina/Marissa will arrange the attestation report at takedown.
4) Commercial: Timothy, confirm PO timeline; Ben will follow up with a one-page SOW and the billing flow.

We will attach the final MAP (Concordat_MAP_v1.pdf) to the MPA and send to Procurement for signature once the PO is visible in HubSpot. Proposed close: May 25 if PO + signed MAP returned by May 21.

Signing off on staging prep — ping me with any blocker.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Concordat_MAP_v1.pdf (finalized 4-page MAP)
